full_judgment: 36. Admittedly, MRR Khatian had been prepared long after the alleged kabala deeds of the plaintiffs and MRR Khatian stands in the name of the original owners Sur Ali and others. The MRR Khatian got a presumption of possession, at least, at the time when the same had been prepared and the correctness of the presumption of possession did not appear to have been rebutted by the plaintiff's side.
